transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I... well. I guess I got a little scared recently. I've just been having some... thoughts. Like, keeping thinking it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. And... sometimes when I'm driving home from the clinic, I catch myself wondering what would happen if I just didn't turn the wheel. So... I thought I should probably come in.
Have these thoughts about not waking up or something happening while you're driving ever become something you actually considered doing? Have you made any plans or felt like you might act on them?

I... no. I don't think so. I haven't... I haven't made any plans. It's just... like I said, those thoughts just kind of pop into my head. The not waking up part, or the driving... it just scared me that I was thinking about it at all. That's why I'm here. I haven't actually... tried to do anything.
Have you noticed that you're not enjoying things the way you used to, or that you've lost interest in activities you once found pleasurable?

Yes... I suppose so. I just... I haven't really touched my camera in a while. And the bird feeders... I usually keep an eye on them, but lately I just... I haven't really cared. Or about the garden. It's just... hard, because those things usually make me feel like... me.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days, and does it last most of the day?

Yes. I... I suppose so. Most days, it just feels like... like the color has drained out of everything. Even when the house is full and busy, I just... I feel so hopeless. Sometimes I just go hide in the laundry room and cry because... I just don't want anyone to see me like that. But yes, it's... it's most of the day.
Have you noticed that you're feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you haven't been doing much physically?

Yes. It's... it's just very hard to get through the day. At work, just walking from the treatment area to the lab benches... it feels like I'm dragging myself through mud. And then... when I get home, I just... I can barely manage to make dinner. Or help with the rest of the evening routine. I'm just... so tired.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently—like eating much less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

I guess it's been... unpredictable. Mostly, I just... I don't really have an appetite. I'll pick at a piece of toast in the morning, maybe have some coffee. And then... I'll get to the end of a shift at the clinic and realize I haven't really eaten anything else all day. I just... don't think about it.
Have you been feeling like you’re worthless or felt guilty about things more than usual lately?

I... yes. I suppose so. I just... I feel like I'm a terrible person lately. I resent all the noise and the disruption at home, and then... then I feel guilty about it. I just keep replaying every time I've been impatient or... or made a sharp comment. It just makes me think that... maybe my husband and the family would be better off without me.
Have you ever felt this way before—like you’re losing interest in things and feeling hopeless most of the day—for at least a couple of weeks at a time?
I... yes. It's been a while. I think it's been hanging over me for... about eleven months now. It's just that... this past month, it's become... unbearable.
Have you ever had a period of time before this one—lasting at least a couple of weeks—where you felt this way, with a loss of interest in things and feeling down most of the day?
I... no. I don't think so. Not that I can remember, anyway. It's really just been... this time.

Have there ever been times when you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or so good that you didn't need sleep, or when people told you that you were acting out of character in a very upbeat or irritable way?

I... well, yes. Briefly. Earlier this month, I suppose. I felt... almost electrically upbeat for a few days. But then I just... I started snapping at everyone over tiny things. Like if a medication cup was misplaced at the clinic, or if the morning schedule changed slightly. It... it didn't really feel like me.
